release.content: pubkit 0.9.0 was released on 2026-10-13 from commit 167ba4587a22a3510536301aa9b058fc8f3b57fd with these changes.

rows: RS-REL-01: a release cites a current quality audit. `pubkit audit --check [PACKAGE VERSION]` passes only on audit/<package>-<version>.md made against the standard pubkit ships with no blocking findings, and `pubkit conform` requires release.json to declare it as a security check
`pubkit audit --standard` prints the sha256 of the standard a report's header names; the rust-crate-quality agent writes a release's report to audit/ with that header
`pubkit new --name --tag` starts a Rust package that passes every check from its first commit, with a release key labelled "<name> release key"

The nightly workflow keeps one pull request per governed repository: the latest pub* pins, then the crate updates cargo vet audits and cargo deny passes (skipped ones listed with cargo vet suggest), dropping the crate commit when it alone fails CI; it never merges and DMs on Slack (`pubkit nightly`, `pins`, `crates`, `record`)
